newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela's Hotel Melia sale hoped for end-April.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela's Hotel Melia sale hoped for end-April.

text.p: The fifth attempted auction of Venezuela's unfinished luxury hotel and shopping complex Hotel Melia is now scheduled for April 30, Banco Industrial de Venezuela (BIV) president Luis Eduardo Brizuela said Friday.
"I hope the auction will take place on April 30 ... we have two investors interested at a a price of about $32 million," he said at a public inauguration ceremony.
Brizuela added that the two potential bidders were from the United States and Brazil.
State-owned BIV inherited the property in November 1994 when the then owner could no longer meet bank payments.
Construction in central Caracas of what is potentially one of the largest and most luxurious hotel complexes in Latin America had started in 1987.
